subject: Request: Headcount safety net & temporary backfill approval
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr-ops@talentpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Headcount safety net & temporary backfill approval

Team —

Short version: Im requesting a temporary headcount safety-net approval for a 3-month backfill for Senior Infra Engineer (IC-3) on the Serving Runtime team. This is due to an unexpected short-term medical leave (effective 2026-07-07) and the role is on a critical path for the July deployment. Were proposing a contractor-to-hire or short-term FTE cover while we run interviews.

Why this is urgent:
- The owner (Rahul Mathur) manages the KV cache and kernel selection work; sprint deliverables in the next 6 weeks are high risk without coverage.
- We have two active hires in pipeline but neither can start before mid-August.
- Delay would likely move the deployment by 3+ weeks and increase cloud spend while we bottleneck on manual workarounds.

Ask:
1) Approve temporary backfill as an exception to the current hiring pause for up to 3 months (contractor or interim FTE).
2) Allow the role to be posted as "temporary backfill" so Talent can source immediately.
3) Provide sign-off on the attached headcount-impact model so finance can provision spend temporarily.

Attachments: headcount-impact-model.xlsx (cost scenarios), org-heatmap-q2.png (team load).

If youre aligned Ill loop in Aria (TalentCo) for candidate shortlist and start a mutual action plan. I can send a condensed note to Execs if you want a one-pager.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

--

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount safety net & temporary backfill approval

Thanks for the clear ask Neha. Quick thoughts:
- I support a 3-month exception for a contractor-to-hire, given impact to the July deploy.
- Two guards: ensure we have a candidate with infra/attention-optimization experience and require weekly checkpoints against the impact model.

Decision point for finance/comms: if we approve, do we classify cost under "deployment contingency" (one-off) or incremental headcount? This affects the central hiring freeze numbers.

Im copying Laura for finance tagging and Markus for scope prioritization. If were all good Ill approve from the exec side and ask Neha to proceed with Talent.

-Vivek

Neha —
I reviewed the headcount-impact-model.xlsx. Finance can approve contingent spend for up to 90 days provided:
1) spend<= $85k total (contractor not exceeding $80/hr equivalent)
2) weekly status and reconciliation against the model (email summary)
3) recruiter submits 3 screened candidates to hiring manager within 7 business days

If Neha can confirm the expected maximum spend and that the role will be re-evaluated before any extension, Ill mark this as an exception in the central hiring tracker.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Finance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: Headcount safety net & temporary backfill approval

Neha —
Agree with the approval. A couple of operational asks from Eng: 
- Please ensure the contractor has prior experience with KV cache management and sequence length optimizations (we can include a technical pre-screen).
- Hold a 30-minute handover session with Rahul before he goes on leave (document critical runbooks).

Also, I propose we re-prioritize two lower-impact tickets from the July milestone so the contractor focuses on the kernel selection and KV cache rollout. Ill update the sprint board today.

-Markus

Hi Neha / team —

Thanks for the details and the attachment. Weve logged the exception request (EP-2026-07-001) and provisionally approve up to 90 days of contractor coverage under the following conditions: 
- Hiring freeze exception EP-2026-07-001 applied; finance sign-off confirmed by Laura.
- Talent team will prioritize a 7-business-day shortlist; Aria is standing by.
- Contractor contract to include a 14-day termination clause and knowledge-transfer deliverable (handover packet).

Next steps:
1) Neha to confirm preferred contractor bill-rate cap (max $80/hr equivalent) and confirm posting language.
2) Aria to submit candidate shortlist and schedule technical screen.
3) Neha & Rahul to book a 30-min handoff before 2026-07-07.

Weve attached the exception form to the EP-2026-07-001 record (internal). Please let us know if you need an Exec note template; otherwise well close the loop on our side once candidates are submitted.

Regards,
HR Operations
TalentPartners (vendor)
